text: Professor Bear here. Did you know that singing is like a full body workout for your brain? Our lyrical literacy project provides songs and detours for anyone wanting to exercise their brain through music. When we sing, we activate more brain regions simultaneously than almost any other activity. Through our collection of tongue twisters, lullababis, and nursery rhymes, we're offering tools to engage multiple neural pathways at once. Just like balanced physical training, singing creates balanced cognitive development. Remember, use it or lose it applies to our brains, too. Visit us to start your musical brain workout today.  Little time.
